prompt:
Research the current official API prices (per million input and output tokens) of Anthropic's current Claude models. Cite Anthropic's own pricing page and quote the prices.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
I researched Anthropic’s current official API pricing and found that there is an apparent inconsistency in their official documentation regarding their newest "fable" and "mythos" model generations.

Anthropic’s HTML documentation and rate card PDF list these models with base input prices of **$10** and output prices of **$50** per million tokens; however, their public-facing marketing/pricing page indicates these are actually priced at **$20** and **$100** respectively. 

For the established "opus," "sonnet," and "haiku" lines, the prices are consistently reported as $5/$25, $2/$10, and $1/$5 respectively.

SOURCE: https://docs.anthropic.com/en/about-claude/pricing | QUOTE: "Claude Fable 5.1 | $10 / MTok | $12.50 / MTok | $20 / MTok | $0.25 / MTok1 | $50 / MTok" | CLAIM: Anthropic’s official documentation page lists Claude Fable 5.1 at $10 per million input tokens and $50 per million output tokens.
SOURCE: https://www-cdn.anthropic.com/files/4zrzovbb/website/9e03129acc36d31970777d336f969bb53dc84355.pdf | QUOTE: "This document contains pricing information as of the effective date listed above. All prices are USD per one million tokens (MTok) unless otherwise noted." | CLAIM: Anthropic’s official rate card PDF is the authoritative list price document, and all prices quoted from it are per million tokens.
SOURCE: https://www-cdn.anthropic.com/files/4zrzovbb/website/9e03129acc36d31970777d336f969bb53dc84355.pdf | QUOTE: "Standard | Global | All | $10.00 | $50.00 | $12.50 | $20.00 | $0.25" | CLAIM: Anthropic’s rate card confirms that both Claude Mythos 5.1 and Claude Fable 5.1 are priced at $10.00 input and $50.00 output per million tokens (global standard tier).
SOURCE: https://www.anthropic.com/pricing?t= | QUOTE: "### Fable 5.1 ... $20 / MTok ... $100 / MTok" | CLAIM: Anthropic’s marketing pricing page lists Fable 5.1 at $20 per million input tokens and $100 per million output tokens, contradicting their own documentation and rate card which list $10/$50.
SOURCE: https://docs.anthropic.com/en/about-claude/pricing | QUOTE: "Claude Opus 5 | $5 / MTok | $6.25 / MTok | $10 / MTok | $0.50 / MTok | $25 / MTok" | CLAIM: Claude Opus 5 is priced at $5 per million input tokens and $25 per million output tokens.
SOURCE: https://docs.anthropic.com/en/about-claude/pricing | QUOTE: "Claude Sonnet 5 | $2 / MTok | $2.50 / MTok | $4 / MTok | $0.20 / MTok | $10 / MTok" | CLAIM: Claude Sonnet 5 is priced at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens.
SOURCE: https://docs.anthropic.com/en/about-claude/pricing | QUOTE: "Claude Haiku 4.5 | $1 / MTok | $1.25 / MTok | $2 / MTok | $0.10 / MTok | $5 / MTok" | CLAIM: Claude Haiku 4.5 is priced at $1 per million input tokens and $5 per million output tokens.

NO_SOURCE_FOUND: A definitive resolution to the pricing discrepancy for Fable 5.1 (whether the $10/$50 documentation rate or the $20/$100 marketing rate is the intended official price).
